name: Maryland SDAT Real Property search
why: Its terms forbid automated collection (scraping). We link to it and never copy from it.

name: Leon County, Florida tax deed portal
why: Its license says the information may not be sold or distributed and is only for deed applications. Link only.

name: RealAuction sites (realtaxdeed.com, realtaxlien.com, realforeclose.com)
why: Private auction platform. No reuse terms found, so we link to county sale pages and never copy parcel data.

why: Private auction platform. No reuse terms found, so we link to county sale pages and never copy parcel data.

name: GovEase
why: Private auction platform. Only privacy and cookie links found, so we link out and never copy parcel data.

name: West Virginia State Auditor's Office
why: Its terms say electronic copies of data from the site are for individual use only and may not be resold or offered for payment without a contract. We link to it and never copy from it.
